sucrerie_bridge_legal_text:
I certify that I am the author of this activity (whether or not assisted by AI), that I have reviewed it, and I authorize its distribution under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license. It respects copyright, GDPR, accessibility, and contains no illegal or discriminatory content.

I may remove it at any time via the management link received by email. La Sucrerie administrators reserve the right to remove any activity that does not comply with the rules of use.
